mapper.insert: INSERT INTO game_score (user_id, game_code, score, secondary_score, played_at, valid) VALUES (#{userId}, #{gameCode}, #{score}, #{secondaryScore}, #{playedAt}, #{valid})
mapper.select:
SELECT gs.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname,
MIN(gs.score) MAX(gs.score) AS score, MAX(gs.secondary_score) AS secondaryScore, MIN(gs.played_at) AS achievedAt FROM game_score gs LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = gs.user_id WHERE gs.game_code = #{gameCode} AND gs.valid = 1 AND gs.played_at >= #{start} AND gs.played_at < #{end} GROUP BY gs.user_id, u.nickname ORDER BY score
ASC DESC ,
MAX(gs.secondary_score) DESC,
MIN(gs.played_at) ASC

SELECT t.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, t.score AS score, t.secondary_score AS secondaryScore FROM ( SELECT gs.user_id, gs.score, gs.secondary_score, gs.played_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY gs.user_id ORDER BY gs.score DESC, gs.secondary_score ASC, gs.played_at ASC ) AS rn FROM game_score gs WHERE gs.game_code = #{gameCode} AND gs.valid = 1 AND gs.played_at >= #{start} AND gs.played_at < #{end} ) t LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.score DESC, t.secondary_score ASC, t.played_at ASC

SELECT t.user_id AS userId, u.nickname AS nickname, t.score AS score, t.secondary_score AS secondaryScore FROM ( SELECT gs.user_id, gs.score, gs.secondary_score, gs.played_at, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY gs.user_id ORDER BY gs.score DESC, gs.secondary_score DESC, gs.played_at ASC ) AS rn FROM game_score gs WHERE gs.game_code = #{gameCode} AND gs.valid = 1 AND gs.played_at >= #{start} AND gs.played_at < #{end} ) t LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.rn = 1 ORDER BY t.score DESC, t.secondary_score DESC, t.played_at ASC
